verdict.rationale: Bento documents outbound webhooks only as a workflow "Send webhook" action that notifies an external system such as a CRM, fulfillment tool, internal app, or support queue (bento-docs-15, bento-docs-30). Because workflows start from triggers like events (bento-docs-46), you can effectively subscribe to events by building one workflow per event, but there is no evidence of a general event-subscription system. missing for 10: a native webhook subscription system with a selectable event catalog, documented payload schemas, signature verification, retry/delivery guarantees, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
